{{Quote|The coordinates are 673117-7rb71."<br />"That will take us into the far Outer Rim. Neutral space.|Cad Bane and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Children of the Force">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref>}}
The '''Rogue Antar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Steniplis sector/Legends|Steniplis sector]] of the far [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] that contained the [[Black Stall Station/Legends|Black Stall Station]]. The [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordinates were 673117-7rb71, as indicated by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was supposedly where captured [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children were being held, but in reality was a trap set by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
